name: Rick Crawford
stance: Supports export-control enforcement to keep advanced AI chips out of adversaries' hands.

statements.text: Cosponsor of the bipartisan Chip Security Act requiring location verification and diversion reporting on advanced AI chips.
Backed bipartisan legislation from Select Committee on the CCP Chairman Moolenaar to stop advanced U.S. AI chips from reaching China through shell companies and smuggling networks.
This is a prudent step toward understanding the capabilities, opportunities, and risks of frontier AI models.

Welcomed a presidential action tasking the NSA with a leading role in collaborating with frontier AI labs, evaluating models and promoting cybersecurity, and urged a closer look at China's access to American compute and chipmaking equipment.

review.note: added October 2026; cosponsorship verified via the lead sponsors' primary release
